#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <queue>
#include <stack>
#include <cstring>
#include <utility>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <iomanip>
#include <cmath>
#include <map>
#include <set>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
typedef pair<ll, ll> pll;

const ll INF = 1LL << 60;

class Graph {
public:
    struct Edge {
        int to, rev;
        ll cap, flow, cost;
        Edge(int t, int r, ll c, ll f, ll co) : to(t), rev(r), cap(c), flow(f), cost(co) {}
    };

    vector<vector<Edge>> adj;
    int n;
    vector<ll> phi;

    Graph(int nodes) : n(nodes), adj(nodes), phi(nodes, 0) {}

    void addEdge(int u, int v, ll cap, ll cost) {
        adj[u].emplace_back(v, adj[v].size(), cap, 0, cost);
        adj[v].emplace_back(u, adj[u].size() - 1, 0, 0, -cost);
    }

    void addFlowWeightedEdge(int u, int v, ll cost, ll cap) {
        if (cap == 0) {
            addEdge(u, v, 0, cost);
        } else {
            addEdge(u, v, cap, cost);
        }
    }

    pll minCostMaxFlow(int source, int sink) {
        ll totalFlow = 0, totalCost = 0;

        while (true) {
            vector<ll> dist(n, INF);
            vector<int> prevNode(n, -1), prevEdge(n, -1);
            dist[source] = 0;
            vector<bool> inQueue(n, false);
            queue<int> q;
            q.push(source);
            inQueue[source] = true;

            while (!q.empty()) {
                int u = q.front(); q.pop();
                inQueue[u] = false;

                for (int i = 0; i < adj[u].size(); ++i) {
                    auto& e = adj[u][i];
                    if (e.cap > e.flow && dist[u] + e.cost + phi[u] - phi[e.to] < dist[e.to]) {
                        dist[e.to] = dist[u] + e.cost + phi[u] - phi[e.to];
                        prevNode[e.to] = u;
                        prevEdge[e.to] = i;
                        if (!inQueue[e.to]) {
                            q.push(e.to);
                            inQueue[e.to] = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if (dist[sink] == INF) break;

            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                if (dist[i] < INF) phi[i] += dist[i];
            }

            ll flow = INF;
            for (int v = sink; v != source; v = prevNode[v]) {
                int e = prevEdge[v];
                flow = min(flow, adj[prevNode[v]][e].cap - adj[prevNode[v]][e].flow);
            }

            for (int v = sink; v != source; v = prevNode[v]) {
                int e = prevEdge[v];
                adj[prevNode[v]][e].flow += flow;
                adj[v][adj[prevNode[v]][e].rev].flow -= flow;
            }

            totalFlow += flow;
            totalCost += flow * (phi[sink] - phi[source]);
        }

        return {totalFlow, totalCost};
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    string s;
    cin >> n >> s;

    vector<int> a(n);
    vector<int> cnt(26, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> a[i];
        cnt[s[i] - 'a']++;
    }

    int extra = 100;
    Graph g(n + extra);
    int source = n + extra - 2;
    int target = source + 1;

    for (int i = 0; i * 2 < n; ++i) {
        g.addFlowWeightedEdge(i, target, 0, 2);
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < 26; ++i) {
        g.addFlowWeightedEdge(source, i + n, 0, cnt[i]);
        for (int j = 0; j * 2 < n; ++j) {
            if (s[j] == s[n - j - 1]) {
                ll w = 0;
                if (s[j] == 'a' + i) {
                    w = -max(a[j], a[n - j - 1]);
                }
                g.addFlowWeightedEdge(i + n, j, w, 1);
            } else {
                ll w = 0;
                if (s[j] == 'a' + i) w -= a[j];
                if (s[n - j - 1] == 'a' + i) w -= a[n - j - 1];
                g.addFlowWeightedEdge(i + n, j, w, 1);
            }
        }
    }

    auto result = g.minCostMaxFlow(source, target);
    cout << -result.second << endl;

    return 0;
}
